contract: Reuse existing play_sound WORD effect_id, Actor* cdecl ABI. Only a successful nonnegative sound channel initializes its row and sets actor+6c to1; channel failure preserves the actor link field. Final close callback still occurs.
scope: Four events/channel-result combinations versus original x86, 132 finite checks: 4049/404a with channel5 and-1, callback order/args, selected row/scratch state and actor link. No other audio modes, audibility or gameplay validation.

canonical_proof.scope: Four original-x86 audio event/channel combinations: events 4049/404a, host channel5/-1. Native/source callback order and arguments, selected row/scratch bytes, actor link field. No audio hardware, other sound modes or gameplay verification.
